_meta.convention: Bone rotations are local XYZ Euler degrees. Pelvis/spine/chest/neck/head: +X pitches forward, +Y yaws left (+X), +Z tilts. Arms: -X swings forward, forearm -X bends elbow forward. Legs: thigh -X raises leg forward, shin +X bends knee backward. All actions default to FK legs/arms (ik=0) with automatic z=0 grounding unless disabled.
